title: High order biorthogonal functions for the discrete de Rham complex on simplices*
summary: It is well known that the choice of basis functions in hp-FEM heavily influences the stability and the computational cost in order to obtain an approximate solution. For simplicial elements in two and three space dimensions, tensor-product-like basis functions built from Jacobi polynomials with different weights yield optimal properties with respect to condition number and sparsity.
